product.title: Your Private Vacation Photography Session In Kyoto

description.text: In Kyoto, this private one-hour photography session pairs a professional photographer with a chosen neighborhood window such as Yasaka Shrine, Gion, or Higashiyama. About 50 edited images are listed after the shoot, with photographer commentary on Kyoto history and culture during the walk. Kimono rental and transport fees are not treated as inclusions. The meeting point is confirmed when booking. The format suits visitors who want guided location shooting without assembling a self-directed photo walk. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Kyoto, and the itinerary stays on Yasaka Shrine, Gion, and Higashiyama that shape this session rather than a full temple-hopping day.
